items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: Right, Roy was there for a few weeks. ... Right, Roy Eldridge was there.

ctx.x: When you were at the Lincoln, Jack tells the story that Roy Eldridge came home from a gig or a recording session and went to bed with the radio on and heard an air shot from the Lincoln Hotel, got dressed and came down and asked to sit in and worked with the band for the rest of the time there.
It's possible, I don't remember it, but I remember Roy being there too. Right, Roy was there for a few weeks. Boy, you're bringing back memories, Bill. Right, Roy Eldridge was there.
That's the guy who, when I was a child, go ask to sit in on other children's bands.
